tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and microservices. Proven track record in API migrations, data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, and headless commerce integration. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile workflows. Experienced in techno-functional delivery, requirements engineering, and solution design across international enterprise e-commerce environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Java / Spring Boot Microservices Specialist - E-Commerce Platform Migration
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of backend engineering experience developing enterprise e-commerce platforms and migrating API architectures at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and RESTful web services. I am eager to contribute my techno-functional capabilities and system integration experience to your e-commerce platform migration initiatives.

bullets.label: Java & Spring Boot Microservices
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend web services and headless APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, following enterprise design patterns and platform best practices.

bullets.label: E-Commerce & API Migrations
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures and e-commerce integrations, improving system stability, transaction performance, and data consistency.

bullets.label: System Integration & Architecture
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms, establishing seamless REST API contracts and data flows across international technical teams.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders and product owners to analyze requirements, write user stories, map business processes, and translate them into scalable solution designs.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit (no sponsorship required). I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15/12/2026, and am available to start on 16/12/2026.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to this opportunity because of the core engineering challenge of migrating complex legacy e-commerce platform architectures into custom Java and Spring Boot microservices. My extensive background in e-commerce backend development, API migration, and enterprise system integration allows me to deliver immediate value in designing resilient RESTful services and connecting e-commerce platforms with backend enterprise systems.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driven by over 5 years of backend e-commerce engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and complex integrations. Excited to bring strong API migration, system integration, and techno-functional capabilities to your e-commerce platform modernization initiative.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Mr. Kukreja, I am a Senior E-Commerce Backend Developer with 5+ years of experience in Java, Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and platform migrations (Rockwell Automation, Shell). I would love to connect regarding your e-commerce microservices migration role!
tailoring.offer: In my first months, I will apply my hands-on Java, Spring Boot, and API migration expertise to help design and implement scalable microservices interfaces, streamline REST web service integrations, and maintain high data consistency between e-commerce and backend platforms.
tailoring.insight: Migrating e-commerce platform capabilities into custom Java/Spring Boot microservices requires clean API contracts and robust data synchronization models. I can leverage my experience in API migrations and PIM/ERP integration pipelines at Rockwell Automation to accelerate this transition effectively.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Java / Spring Boot Microservices Specialist - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Mr. Kukreja,

I am a Senior Backend Developer with over 5 years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, and microservices using Java and Spring Boot at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am excited to support your e-commerce migration to custom Java/Spring Boot microservices. I offer deep experience in API migrations, solution design, and complex PIM/ERP system integrations. Migrating commerce functionality to microservices requires clean API contracts and synchronized data pipelines, where my background will deliver immediate impact. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
